parse_mmcif_string_to_structure: parse an mmCIF string into an AlphaFold 3 Structure object with optional fixes for MSE residues and arginines
parse_parsed_mmcif_object_to_structure: construct a Structure from an already parsed mmCIF object with control over water, bonds, and model selection
build_structure_from_atom_arrays: build a Structure from raw atom-level NumPy arrays including coordinates, residue IDs, and chain IDs
build_structure_from_sequences_and_bonds: build a minimal Structure from sequence strings and bonded atom pairs using the chemical components dictionary
extract_tables_from_mmcif: extract chain, residue, and atom tables from a parsed mmCIF with options for fixing residues and including water
